tailoring.headline: Senior Java Enterprise & E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and microservices. Hands-on experience across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), API integrations, and data pipelines connecting PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven delivery in agile environments with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and database performance tuning. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SENIOR JAVA ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT
cover_en.hook: Your search for a senior enterprise e-commerce professional aligns perfectly with my background. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and scaling enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and complex backend integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, ensuring scalable product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters to support seamless data flows across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Optimization
bullets.text: Engineered high-performance data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

bullets.label: Cloud & CI/CD Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce experience can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and Java development experience to your organization. Having engineered robust backend solutions, RESTful APIs, and complex system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your high-performance enterprise architecture and scalable platform initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience to build scalable architectures and high-performance API integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a senior Java and e-commerce developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable backend platforms, REST APIs, and enterprise integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I would love to connect regarding your enterprise architecture openings.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Java Enterprise Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Java Enterprise Architect role. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java and Spring backend services, and complex API integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to deliver immediate value to your team.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and my earliest available start date is 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
